'''''Fleet Tactics and Combat Methodology''''', or '''''Fleet Combat and Methodology''''' was a book on [[Starship/Legends|starship]] warfare written by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Ackbar]]. It was the standard manual for students at the [[New Republic Fleet Academy]].
